name: stock-sst-to-exact-nasa-sstm-incompressible-relative-diagnostic
objective: Measure the effect of replacing packaged OpenFOAM kOmegaSST by the source-audited exact NASA TMR SSTm equations while keeping the same incompressible solver, mesh, conditions, fields, transport, numerics, and force definitions.
validation_status: planned_diagnostic_only; strict Gate 3 remains downstream of failed Gate 1

source.entry_gate: diagnostic_numerics_passed must be true; force agreement may be reported as failed but does not authorize validation

fixed_invariants: NASA TMR altered closed NACA 0012 897x257 mesh and every polyMesh file
alpha=0 deg, U=51.4815 m/s, nu=8.58e-6 m2/s, chord Reynolds number 6000174.825
incompressible simpleFoam solver and constant kinematic-viscosity transport
all final U, p, k, omega, and nut fields copied from the numerically accepted stock-SST diagnostic
linearUpwind velocity, k, and omega convection
force coefficient axes, density, reference area, reference length, and quarter-chord moment center

runtime_image.reason: The exact runtime model is not part of packaged OpenFOAM and must be dynamically registered in an otherwise derived image.

declared_changes.equation_delta: NASA TMR SSTm F1/F2 mapping and vorticity limiter, factor-20 production limiter only in k, and P=mu_t*S^2 in both production terms.

predeclared_outputs.primary_effect: mean Cd(exact SSTm) minus mean Cd(stock SST) over each final 100-iteration window
predeclared_outputs.settling: final-100 peak-to-peak <= max(0.001, 1% of absolute coefficient mean)
predeclared_outputs.trend: projected absolute change over 500 iterations within Cd 0.0002, Cl 0.004, and CmPitch 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.residuals: final-100 maximum initial residual <= 1e-5 for p, Ux, Uy, k, and omega
predeclared_outputs.zero_angle_symmetry: absolute mean Cl <= 0.004 and absolute mean quarter-chord CmPitch <= 0.0002
predeclared_outputs.force_agreement: absolute mean Cd minus NASA CFL3D SST Cd <= 0.0002

decision_rule: If the stock-SST entry gate fails, do not construct or execute this rung from its unconverged fields. If it passes, retain and report the exact-SSTm result regardless of force agreement. Strict validation remains blocked by failed Gate 1 and no result is accepted for rocket design.
